description:
Owner's law (2026-07-02): follow_up is an anti-northstar SMELL. Work runs for exactly two reasons: a consumer WAITS on a named fact/product (pull), or a CHANGED REVISION wakes a recorded reader. Owner's sharpening: "if a push-based / pass-based idea is being smuggled back in under a different name, that's a violation of the spirit of the pull/demand based approach. period."

DOC ALIGNMENT: the blanket rule is pull-based.html's Non-negotiable; northstar.html still tolerates follow_up for legacy jobs -- this arc retires that tolerance (update northstar.html's clause at arc close).

FAMILY 1 — DONE (e561842ce): seed_root's LowerFunction/PlanEntryDispatch pushes, always-coalesced, deleted.
FAMILY 2 — DONE (1ab96d652): seed_activation's AnalyzeActivation push redundant, deleted; seed_root's twin named family 3's gap.
FAMILY 3 — DONE (d8fa56ed1): scheduler demands-on-stall via the unified fact->producer map; seed_root's last push deleted; 19 push-dependent tests pass unmodified.
FAMILY 4 — DONE (d9b5f0112): body.rs push-free (~70 threading refs deleted); TypeDefined/GuardDispatch arms added; blocked-waiter drain expansion (demand_blocked_wait_producers) closes chain ignition in the product loops; the TEMPORARY PUMP (concluded-without-claiming producers stay re-demandable, for semantic.rs's conclude-by-omission AnalyzeActivation) marked in code with removal condition; measured 0 healthy / 37-per-compile pathological.
FAMILY 5 — DONE (folded 2026-07-03, audited PASS/PASS): dispatch.rs/contract.rs/types.rs push-free — 6 absence-gated wait+push pairs converted to bare waits (wait KINDS preserved exactly, incl. the wait_on_current ModuleDefined site); one NEW arm ModuleDefined->DefineModule (grep-verified single-producer, jobs/source.rs:158); no converted chain leans on the pump (every producer claims its output on its concluding path); missing-module path audited: terminates as a reported genuine stall (ModuleIndexed has no arm; blocked producers not re-demanded). Audit note: the new arm also pre-benefits the unconverted ModuleDefined waits in semantic.rs:1299/1645/1673 and keying.rs:136.

FAMILY 6+ (remaining; ref counts at family-5 fold): jobs/semantic.rs 66 (the big one -- includes the conclude-by-omission AnalyzeActivation pump target, the DefineModule(protocol) watch item at :1255-1258, and the FunctionContract wait+push at :1488 whose producer concludes-by-omission when no contract is declared -- converting THAT site needs either a FunctionContract arm + always-claim in derive_function_contract, or the wait stays gated on function_declares_contract); jobs/keying.rs 8; jobs/root.rs 8 (the early-return wait-path forwards of world.rs helpers); world.rs 4 (wait_for_function_definition/wait_for_type_decl helpers -- the pushes live HERE; dispatch/contract/types still call them and forward unchanged, correctly); quoted_expander.rs 4; jobs/source.rs 3; source_publish.rs 2. Cosmetic ride-along for the world.rs family: retire/reshape JobEffects::wait_on_current's follow-up parameter (family 5 left a wait_on_current(fact, []) idiom).

TELEMETRY GAP: add an aggregate follow-up-emission counter (or extend session-finished) before declaring the final family complete (pull-based.html's follow_ups=0 proof).

WATCH ITEMS: (1) semantic.rs:1255-1258 DefineModule(protocol) producer relationship; (2) coalesced-telemetry conflation (scheduler.rs) -- split observability at arc close; (3) Scheduler::blocked/has_run pub-visibility sweep at arc close; (4) product wait loops lack a stall_demanded-style suppression memo (stuck fixtures burn the 50k budget before erroring -- fix when fz-go4.19 dedups the loops).

DONE = rg shows zero production follow_up emissions; JobEffects::follow_up field deleted; the .18.19 coalesce screen deleted; the temporary pump tightened; scheduler wake paths = changed-revision only plus the submit_root ignition; docs updated (fact-engine.md legacy clause dropped; northstar.html tolerance clause updated). Sequencing: fz-go4.18.31 AFTER the semantic.rs family.

comments.text: STARTING INVENTORY from the .18.19 removable-code audit (2026-07-02, at 424b2ae6a): (1) FIRST REMOVAL, proof complete: seed_root's LowerFunction + PlanEntryDispatch follow_ups (root.rs:75-76) are provably ALWAYS-COALESCED — the concluding branch requires Recursive+DispatchMask facts, whose producers (keying.rs:148-152 -> body.rs:287; keying.rs:84-90 -> dispatch.rs:169) must therefore have concluded; first-run demand already lives in DeriveRecursive/DeriveDispatchMask; change waves handle re-runs. Safe to delete as this arc's first family (own commit). (2) KEEP-classified: root.rs:77/:112 AnalyzeActivation (genuine first-run demand for a just-minted activation); ALL other emissions are absence-gated wait+demand pairs (semantic.rs:219/1257/1301/1492/1647/2265, dispatch, body, keying, source, world.rs:2094/2102, quoted_expander, source_publish) — these are the wait-implies-demand conversion targets. (3) Product-side jobs (artifact/runtime_demand/transport/backend/native) emit ZERO follow_ups already. (4) Minor: the coalesced telemetry channel conflates agenda-dedupe (scheduler.rs:257) with standing-conclusion suppression (scheduler.rs:228-232) — split the observability when this arc lands. (5) Watch item from the cross-lane note: semantic.rs:1255-1258 demands DefineModule(protocol) while waiting on ProtocolDispatch — the one site where a follow_up forced a concluded job's re-run as a wait-unblocking mechanism; resolve its real producer relationship during migration.

title: Migrate the semantic layer off follow_up: work runs only via waits (pull) or changed-revision wakes
